notes: Identity is solid and matched on four facts in one indexed official page: 'Dr. Sandhya Vaddadi - Best Pediatric Oncologist in Hyderabad | Rainbow Children's Hospital' at /all/doctor/hyderabad/SECUNDERABAD/children-care-hospital/dr-sandhya-vaddadi-pediatric-hematologist-oncologist - name + specialty (paediatric haematology-oncology) + hospital (Rainbow) + BRANCH (Secunderabad, exactly as the source row states) + city. 'Vaddadi' is a distinctive Telugu surname and no rival same-name clinician surfaced, so there is no ambiguity. Band is Medium, honestly and deliberately: only ONE official domain carries her (rainbowhospitals.in - the doctor page plus the group's paediatric oncology speciality page plus the Secunderabad centre page, which per section 5 count as one source). Her LinkedIn corroborates name + hospital but is self-published and cannot earn High. Vaidam, HexaHealth, myUpchar, Sulekha, Afronile, DoctorsGallery and Medycity are corroborating-only. No independent government, university or second-hospital source was found. NO EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED, and this is a deliberate blank rather than a gap in effort. Rainbow does not publish per-doctor email or phone on its doctor pages. Rainbow branch numbers appeared ONLY inside a WebSearch synthesised summary, and were rejected on two grounds: first, the summary gave IDENTICAL numbers for the Banjara Hills and Secunderabad branches, which is a classic synthesis artefact; second, the mandatory exact-phrase re-check of '"9676838787" Rainbow Children's Hospital' returned nothing about the Indian Rainbow group at all - every result concerned the unrelated UH Rainbow Babies & Children's Hospital in Cleveland, Ohio. Those numbers were therefore DISCARDED. The group helpline (1800 2122) is already supplied by the pipeline's hospital fallback, so it is not duplicated here. The Karkhana/Secunderabad street address IS published on multiple directory listings and is recorded in indirect_details as an actionable practice location. owns_clinic is false - no evidence of a separate clinic entity, which matches the expected pattern for Rainbow paediatric sub-specialists. RAINBOW URL PATTERN FINDING (relevant to the ~100 Rainbow rows that follow): (a) YES, rainbowhospitals.in publishes per-doctor profile pages, and they index well; (b) the pattern observed verbatim is https://www.rainbowhospitals.in/all/doctor/<city>/<branch-slug>/<facility-type-slug>/dr-<name-slug>-<specialty-slug> ; (c) it encodes BOTH branch and specialty - this row's branch segment is 'secunderabad' and its specialty suffix is 'pediatric-hematologist-oncologist'. There are also branch/specialty listing families at /doctors/best-<specialty>-in-<locality> , /children-care-hospital/speciality/<specialty>-hospital , /our-centre/hyderabad/<branch> and a group roster at /our-doctors .
